sections.indications_and_usage: Uses For the temporary relief of minor aches and pains of muscles and joints associated with: simple backache arthritis strains bruises sprains
sections.dosage_and_administration: Directions adults and children 12 years of age and older: apply to affected area not more than 3 to 4 times daily children under 12 years of age: do not use, consult a doctor
sections.warnings_and_cautions: Warnings For external use only. Avoid contact with the eyes. Do not apply on wounds or irritated skin bandage tightly Stop use and ask doctor immediately if condition worsens symptoms persist for more than 7 days or clear up and occur again within a few days If pregnant or breast-feeding, ask a health care professional before use. Keep out of reach of children. If swallowed get medical help, or contact a Poison Control Center immediately.
